g.title: j246758138
g.text: 當那些被徵召者到來時，三種能量在我的體內扭曲融合，那麼第四種能量就不那麼令人驚訝了。這個巨大而可怕的東西，渴望像地殼一樣將我撕裂，然後傾瀉而出。

g.title: j1972782330
g.text: I remember your promise to me. And that I have found such a place in your heart that you keep me in such a purgatorial state? Thank you, my pet. Thank you.

g.title: j2933207261
g.text: 我竟在你心中佔據了如此重要的位置，以至於你讓我一直處於這種煉獄般的境地？謝謝你，我的寶貝。謝謝你。

g.title: j2294477451

g.text: 羅瑟，你不是由你的過去所定義。你是由你的未來所定義。而且你仍然有未來可以生活，你不像其他在長胴鼓之夜死去的 Orokin。

g.title: j1977674193
g.text: 玩這些遊戲。被別人牽著鼻子走。做被期望的事情。在被期望的時候。以被期望的方式。打別人的戰爭。這就是正在將你撕裂的東西。

g.title: j2491437591
g.text: 我知道。這一切都不公平。但生活本來就不公平，不是嗎？但你已經習慣了。而且你也習慣了想辦法應付。

g.title: j268050262

g.text: Okay. I'll... I'll do it. I'll wipe your mind again. Even if it'll take Marie and Lyon's with it.

g.title: j905964980
g.text: No. I refuse. I'll find another way to convince you to move forward.

g.title: j3113008827
g.text: I need some time to think this through.

g.title: j3234733652
g.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.

g.title: j775633718
g.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.

g.title: j2268830788
g.text: Do what you will, Usurper.

g.title: j3634566927
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j19276136
g.text: I wish you the best of luck.

g.title: j3823340462
g.text: Time does seem to be something we have in abundance, doesn't it?

g.title: j2446000720
g.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.

g.title: j3257705303
g.text: What say you?

g.title: j2347935420
g.text: Good. Get to it. I tire of living with this knowledge in my skull, Usurper.
